paper_metadata.title: Effect of Nb-C addition on the microstructure and mechanical properties of CoCrFeMnNi high entropy alloys during homogenisation

evidence.quote: In the present paper, CoCrFeMnNi(NbC) alloy was designed based on theoretical calculations and proposed as a novel high entropy alloy.

SEM-WDX analysis showed a very limited number of Nb-rich precipitates in as-cast samples, whereas no Nb-rich precipitates was observed in homogenised samples

After casting, the microstructure primarily consisted of a dendritic structure. SEM-WDX analysis showed that the dendritic structure was rich in Fe and Mn, whereas interdendritic areas were rich in Co, Cr, Ni. Furthermore, the results suggested that the dendrite size was similar in both alloys, i.e. 2.2±0.7 and 2.6±0.7 µm in CoCrFeMnNi and CoCrFeMnNiNbC alloys, respectively.

two types of recrystallisation twinning were widely observed in both alloys after homogenisation (Fig. 4). One type of recrystallisation twins has a fully parallel-sided morphology so that their ends are located at grain boundaries. The other type included recrystallisation twins that one end of them was located at grain boundaries (GB-side) and the other end was stopped at grain interior (interior-side).
